spans.s:
सौगत सौगत, अस्, m. (fr. सु-गत), a fol-
lower of Su-gata, q. v.; a Buddhist, (the Buddhists
are said to be divided into four classes or schools,
viz. Mādhyamikas, Yogācāras, Sautrāntikas, and
Vaibhāṣikas); N. of a son of Daśa-ratha.

सौगन्ध सौगन्ध, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. सु-गन्-
ध), possessing a fragrant odour, sweet-scented,
fragrant; (अम्), n. sweet-scentedness, fragrance; a
particular fragrant grass (= कत्-तृण).

सौगन्धिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, sweet-scented,
fragrant; (अस्), m. a dealer in perfumes; sulphur;
N. of a mountain; (आ), f. a kind of lotus; (अम्),
n. the white water-lily, the blue lotus; a kind of
fragrant grass (= कत्-तृण); a ruby.

सौगन्ध्य, अम्, n. sweetness of odour, fra-
grance, perfume.

सौगम्य सौगम्य, अम्, n. (fr. सु-गम),
easiness of access, easiness of attainment, facility.
